risk_if_not_implemented: Without Non-Repudiation, required evidence, logs and chain-of-custody integrity may be unavailable or unreliable when needed for investigation or legal proceedings. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss of Accountability / Attribution (R-AC-1), Loss of Investigative / Evidentiary Capability (R-IR-1), Loss of Authenticity / Provenance (R-IP-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Fraud, Corruption and/or Intentional Criminal Conduct (MT-14), Cryptographic Compromise / Cryptanalytic Capability Advancement (MT-31).

compensating_control_1.name: Cryptographic Hash
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to utilize hash algorithms to generate a hash value that can be used to validate the integrity of data and/or software.
compensating_control_1.justification: Cryptographic Hash (CRY-14) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Non-Repudiation (MON-34) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Protection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to protect event logs, security-relevant telemetry and audit tools from unauthorized access, modification and deletion.
compensating_control_2.justification: Protection of Event Logs & Security-Relevant Telemetry (MON-12) provides detective monitoring capability that compensates for the absence of Non-Repudiation (MON-34) by identifying unauthorized, anomalous, or non-compliant activity that the primary control would have prevented. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
